taxonomy.note: Accepted by Kew/POWO; learner stays species-level.
synonyms: Scutellaria integrifolia var. brevifolia A.Gray ex E.Hall

evidence: BONAP/NAPA provides a county-level map for Scutellaria wrightii.
Hays County — UT Plant Resources Center's Purola Preserve natural flora lists S. wrightii among naturally occurring plants.
Travis County — UT Plant Resources Center's Travis County Lamiaceae specimen index includes S. wrightii.
Williamson County — UT Plant Resources Center publishes a dedicated Williamson County treatment for S. wrightii.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Nursery and garden occurrences are not used as native-county proof. The PASS rests on native-flora/herbarium/county-treatment evidence.

morphology.look_here_first: First look at the plant base and leaf tips. Wright's skullcap is a low bushy perennial with many stems from a persistent base and small entire leaves with rounded/obtuse tips. Its hairs are minute and the calyx can look nearly smooth to the naked eye. Then confirm the larger upward-curving blue-violet corolla and visorlike skullcap calyx.
diagnostic_traits: perennial herb, taprooted, several-many-stemmed at the base, usually 10–20 cm tall
stems four-sided, densely puberulent with minute sessile glandular hairs
leaves opposite and decussate, short-petiolate, ovate to elliptic
leaf margins entire and tips rounded/obtuse
leafy raceme with paired axillary flowers, often oriented mainly to one side
calyx two-lipped with a projecting visorlike scutellum; puberulent but often smoother-looking than S. drummondii
corolla mostly 13–18 mm long, with a cylindric tube that curves upward and a violet throat
fruit produces four small minutely warty nutlets

confusers.separator: S. drummondii is an annual with acute-tipped leaves, more conspicuous glandular hairs, shorter pedicels (about 1–1.2 mm) and smaller corollas (about 5.5–10 mm). S. wrightii is perennial/bushy, round-tipped and larger-flowered.
S. ovata is much taller and rhizomatous, with large triangular-ovate leaves having truncate/subcordate bases and crenate margins; its corolla is about 21–25 mm.

diagnostic_roles: whole bushy perennial habit and persistent base
opposite entire leaves showing rounded tips
flower side showing larger upward-curving corolla
photo_verification.provenance_note: Prioritize side views showing the upward bend of the corolla, rounded leaf tips, and a clean calyx/scutellum close-up.

installation_guardrail: Do not install until Calvin explicitly approves the reconciled Scutellaria batch.
